comments.author: brianpgordon
comments.story: Emergent Tool Use from Multi-Agent Interaction
comments.why: Earlier artificial life simulator the commenter remembers being amazed by.
comments.text: This is incredible. The various emergent behaviors are fascinating. I remember being amazed a decade ago by the primitive graphics in artificial life simulators like Polyworld: [LINK] [VIDEO] It seems that OpenAI has a great little game simulated for their agents to play in. The next step to make this even cooler would be to use physical, robotic agents learning to overcome challenges in real meatspace!

comments.story: OpenWorm: A Digital Organism In Your Browser
comments.why: Polyworld as an interesting idea of developing AI through evolution.
comments.text: As much as I understood, this project isn't so much about AI, as it is about a better understanding of biology. I don't know if the project still lives, or are there other many such works, but Polyworld seemed like an interesting idea (developing AI through evolution): [VIDEO]
